browser.tab_missing: Tab {name} is not open yet: run the step that opens it first (popup: {name})
browser.any_frame_scope: anyFrame searches from the page; it cannot be relative to another element (such as extract fields)
contract.secret_missing: Secret {name} is not set: set it under "Logins & secrets" in the Portal, or set an environment variable with the same name
run.input_failed: {count} input problem(s); the browser was not started
run.deadline_before_stage: The deadline had passed; this stage did not start
run.deadline_killed: The deadline passed; the subprocess and browser were terminated
run.deadline_in_stage: The deadline ran out during this stage
run.deadline_before_publish: The deadline ran out before the outputs were published
run.process_failed: The subprocess exited with code {code}; see {log}
run.facts_missing: The automation did not write facts.json
run.verify_failed: {count} independent assertion(s) failed; the first is "{name}"
run.candidate_missing: assertion.py did not write candidate outputs
run.cancelled: Stopped by the user; the subprocess was terminated
installed.missing_hint: {browser} has not been downloaded on this computer. Run {command} in the project folder, then run again (no need to restart the Portal).
child.invalid_scenario: The scenario did not pass validation
child.profile_fallback: Could not use the warmed Firefox profile, using a fresh one instead: {error}
report.name: Name
report.no_output: No outputs: they are published only when every stage passes.
report.no_screenshot: No screenshot: the run may have failed before the browser started, or the deadline ran out.
run.login_missing: This scenario logs in as role {role}, which is not registered yet; add it under "Logins & secrets" in the Portal
run.login_state_missing: The login state file of role "{role}" does not exist
run.login_not_checked: Login state loaded (not checked whether it is still valid)
run.login_secret_missing: Automatic login for role "{role}" needs these secrets: {names}
run.needs_login: Role "{role}" needs to log in again; no steps were run. Log in and run it again.
run.login_refreshed: Role "{role}" was not logged in or its login had expired; it was logged in automatically
login.browser_closed: The browser was closed before the login state could be read; log in again and press "Finish login" in the Portal
login.local_refused: Could not open {url}: {host} is the computer running this browser itself, and no site is listening there. If the site runs on another computer (for example the test site on the server), change the role's login and check URLs to that computer's address, such as http://server:8765/login.
login.refused: Could not connect to {url} (connection refused): check the address and port, that the site is running, and that this computer can reach it.
debug.snapshot_not_found: The within locator matches nothing on the current page
debug.inputs_not_object: Inputs must be a JSON object
contract.input_dynamic: The dynamic value of input {name} is wrong: {detail}
steplog.title: Automation log: {id} {name}
steplog.about: This file records step by step what the automation stage (driving the browser) did: when each step ended, its result and duration, and the error and URL when it failed. For the whole run, see report.html.
steplog.done: Done: all {total} steps passed in {seconds} s.
steplog.facts: Facts extracted from the page: {names} (values in facts.json)
steplog.next: The independent checks run next; see report.html for the final result.
steplog.timed_out_step: Timed out: the run deadline ran out at step {n} “{name}” after {seconds} s.
steplog.failed_before: Failed before the first step (for example the browser did not start) after {seconds} s.
steplog.timed_out_before: Timed out: the run deadline ran out before the first step, after {seconds} s.
steplog.evidence: The screen at the failure is in screenshot.png; the error and URL are in diagnostic.json.
steplog.details: Full error message (as reported by the browser automation library):
contract.file_upload: The file "{file}" of input {name} was not delivered to this computer (it may have been deleted after the retention period); upload it again
contract.file_attachment: The scene attachment {file} of input {name} is not in this revision
contract.file_not_found: The file {file} of input {name} does not exist or is not a file
contract.file_not_allowed: The file {file} of input {name} is not in an allowed folder; add its folder in the settings of the Worker app that runs it
contract.file_unreadable: The file "{file}" of input {name} cannot be read: {detail}
contract.file_too_large: The file "{file}" of input {name} is too large: {size}; the limit is {limit}
contract.file_type: The file "{file}" of input {name} is not an accepted type (accept: {accept})
contract.files_too_large: The files of this run are too large in total: {size}; the limit is {limit}
browser.chooser_unhandled: This step opened a file chooser without any file to choose (it was closed automatically); if a file should be uploaded here, change the step to upload and use trigger for this element
browser.upload_not_prepared: Input {name} has no prepared file; upload or choose a file for the input first
browser.upload_single: This file input accepts a single file, but several files were given; use a single file, or check that the locator points to an input that accepts several files
browser.upload_not_input: This element is not a file input (<input type=file>): point target at the file input itself; use trigger for a button that opens a file chooser when clicked
browser.drop_too_large: The dropped files total {size}, more than the drop zone limit of {limit}; use target or trigger instead
run.input_failed_script: {count} input problem(s); the script was not run
run.runtime_failed: Could not prepare RPA Python runtime {major}: {detail}
run.runtime_platform: This Python node runs only on {platforms}; this computer is {platform}
run.runtime_prepared: Prepared runtime {version} for the first time in {ms} ms
